acceptance_predicates.description: A clean clone installs and launches with dev as the default channel using bounded temporary state.
Selected channel persists across restart and a dev upgrade preserves the active channel and provenance.
Tamper, partial-install, timeout, and rollback faults produce bounded typed diagnostics and clean temporary state.
Human-readable output is default and --json remains machine-readable for every smoke step.
Missing development authentication, signatures, and key management never block the smoke.

definition_of_done: Disposable exact-head ASB/TUI smoke passes with a digest-bound receipt.
Independent review and required hosted checks are green.

outputs.description: Clean-room channel consumption and rollback receipt.

gates.description: Required hosted checks pass on exact reviewed heads.
